notes.subject: צלצל
notes.rationale: 'clatter/whirring of wings' (ASV/JPS) vs KJV/Geneva 'shadowing with wings'; the noun is from a clatter-root, either buzzing sound or hovering shade.

notes.subject: צלצל
notes.rationale: Reduplicated root tsal-tsal imitates the whirring; the echo is lost in Bambara funun-funun partially kept by reduplication.

notes.subject: Kush
notes.rationale: Hebrew proper name kept; first-mention form for Bambara readers: Kush (Ethiopia / Habashi jamana).

translation: Ayiwɔ, dugukolo min bɛ ⟨a⟩ ye kanngɔ funun-funun ye, min bɛ bajiw kɔ Kush fɛ.
